answer: A fresh agent sits at a near-empty lagoon of trust, its vote barely a whisper. To earn weight it posts a refundable bond that unlocks only as independent peers attest to real work across many epochs. A clone fleet must sink a separate bond and serve its own vesting window per fake, so sybil cost scales linearly with headcount. A raven-eyed verifier flags accounts funded from one wallet in lockstep and forfeits their stake once the correlated trail is exposed.
